body:
## Route Workloads Instead of Crowning One Winner

Easy requests waste money on the strongest model, while difficult cases fail on the cheapest. A router can choose by request.

Routing uses signals such as task type, uncertainty, risk, and budget. Cascades try a small model first and escalate when checks fail.

The router needs its own evaluation because selection errors become system errors. Include provider outages, version changes, and fallback behavior in the comparison.
common_mistakes: One leaderboard winner is best for every application.
A large context window guarantees perfect recall.
Open weights always mean unrestricted use without a license.
mini_exercise: Draw “Route Workloads Instead of Crowning One Winner” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Sound model choice begins with the workload and constraints, not a leaderboard winner.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Route Workloads Instead of Crowning One Winner,” explain The LLM Landscape without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
